keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep jobs whose title, company, tags or description contain ANY of these words (e.g. python, devops, designer). Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs containing any of these words in the title or tags (e.g. intern, junior).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Job boards to query. Default is all.

minSalaryUsd.title: Minimum yearly salary (USD)
minSalaryUsd.description: Only keep jobs that publish a salary at or above this. 0 disables the filter.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many jobs (newest first).
